_comment: Merge policy applied by build.js on top of the research. shop_level: recorded once on the shop profile (shop-wide default), never in a listing form: shop-wide policies, GST invoicing, and registrations held by the business (eMigrate RC, AMFI ARN, SEBI/IRDAI/ICAI/CoA registration). form_optional: shown in the basic form but not enforced, because the rule applies only to some items (perishables, allergen-containing food, services that offer a warranty, RERA-registrable projects, mutual-fund distributors, overseas recruitment).
